subject: Helix Analytics x Redwood — Roundtable sponsorship & mini-demo plan
messages:
From: Mira Patel <mira.patel@consultify.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@helixanalytics.com>, Helix Events <events@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation — small roundtable + mini-demo at CloudOps Week (sponsorship)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the intro last month — Helix loved the pilot metrics you shared. Helix is putting together a small vendor roundtable the week before CloudOps Week (July 20) — 30–40 architects and platform leads, 60 minute slot. Consultify is managing logistics for sponsors.

We wanted to float a joint slot: a 15-minute Helix opening (infrastructure cost observability) + 15-minute Redwood mini-demo (cost-aware inference routing / batching examples) + 15-minute customer panel + 15-minute live Q&A. Sponsorship would include: logo on event page, email blast to the invite list (~2k), and a single follow-up co-branded blog.

Are you open to sponsoring with Helix and co-presenting a mini-demo showing Redwood’s batching + caching wins? High-level cost is $9k sponsorship fee (details attached). If this looks promising, can we get a draft agenda and a quick handoff call?

Best,
Mira Patel
Partnerships Lead, Consultify
attachments: roundtable-draft-agenda.docx, sponsorship-term-sheet.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@consultify.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — small roundtable + mini-demo at CloudOps Week (sponsorship)

Hi Mira — thanks for the note and the materials.

This is aligned with our partner events playbook. A couple quick asks before I loop in Enablement:
- Can you confirm attendee profile (percent infra vs data science vs product)? We want platform/infra heavy.
- Confirm the timeline: is this July 13 or July 17 slot (the week prior)?
- Can Helix nominate a single customer for the panel?

Camila — can you scope a 15-minute mini-demo (live) that showcases: 1) one latency-sensitive route failover to a cheaper quantized model and 2) prefix cache hit that reduces token cost? Need a 5-minute pre-recorded fallback in case of infra flakiness.

Jonas — assuming sponsorship, we should offer the co-branded blog and a short benchmark snippet for the post-event asset.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week. Calendly: https://calendly.com/sofia-ivanova/30min

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Developer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com
From: Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@helixanalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mira Patel <mira.patel@consultify.io>, Helix Events <events@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — small roundtable + mini-demo at CloudOps Week (sponsorship)

Sofia — quick answers: attendee mix will be ~65% infra/platform engineers, 20% SRE/ops, 15% data platform/product. The confirmed slot is July 17, 11:00–12:00 PT. Helix will nominate Acme Retail’s infra lead for the panel (pending Acme approval).

We can do a short run-through with your demo lead on July 10. Sponsorship fee includes the blog and a single-email blast.

Ethan
Sr. Events Manager, Helix Analytics
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@consultify.io>, Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — small roundtable + mini-demo at CloudOps Week (sponsorship)

Thanks — excited to move forward. Attaching a proposed demo script and a one-pager highlighting the two demo scenarios (live + fallback).

Plan summary:
- 10:55–11:00: stage setup & mic check
- 11:00–11:15: Helix intro (cost observability highlights)
- 11:15–11:30: Redwood mini-demo (live path + pre-recorded fallback)
- 11:30–11:45: customer panel (Acme Retail rep + Helix PM)
- 11:45–12:00: live Q&A

Jonas — we’ll need a 300–400 word co-branded post-event recap and a 120-word LinkedIn blurb. Can you put together the benchmark snippet and quick graph export by July 21?

Attachments: redwood-helix-onepager.pdf, roundtable-draft-agenda.docx

Camila Reyes
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mira Patel <mira.patel@consultify.io>, Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — small roundtable + mini-demo at CloudOps Week (sponsorship)

All good from my side. I ran a quick token-cost delta for the proposed demo scenario (50 concurrent short sessions, 128 token avg):
- Baseline (no caching, float32 model): ~1200 token-seconds / min
- With prefix cache + INT8 quantized fallback: ~420 token-seconds / min (~65% token-efficiency)

I’ll export the benchmark figure and a 2-line methodology note for the co-branded post by EOD July 21.

Jonas Weber
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Mira Patel <mira.patel@consultify.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@helixanalytics.com>, Helix Events <events@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — small roundtable + mini-demo at CloudOps Week (sponsorship)

Fantastic — this is exactly what we wanted. I shared the sponsorship contract and DocuSign link to Helix legal and copied you on the envelope. Please sign the DocuSign by July 6 to lock in the slot.

Next steps we’ll track:
1) Redwood signs sponsorship (by July 6) — Sofia
2) Demo run-through (July 10) — Camila + Helix engineer
3) Benchmark export & blog draft (by July 21) — Jonas
4) Pre-event promo copy (by July 8) — Helix + Redwood marketing

Looking forward to working together — see DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ABC-Helix-Sponsor-2026

Best,
Mira Patel
Partnerships Lead, Consultify
